items.content_html:
Fix a flaky test in fzf-lua that's causing build failures.

https://hydra.nixos.org/build/292958691

I submitted a fix upstream in ibhagwan/fzf-lua#1914, but marked it as draft because it's yet to be seen if this will actually resolve the issue on Hydra.

I was able to fix the same error on my own GitHub Actions workflow though.

  • Failing commit
  • Fixed commit This just coincidentally passed because the overlay didn't properly apply to vimPlugins.fzf-lua due to multiple mistakes. Another fix did pass though, but this could be by coincidence too.
